note: The career's paddock press (track-viewer/src/game/career/media.js). 'images': which press photos exist per driver, in track-viewer/public/assets/drivers/<slug>/media/<mood>.webp (portrait, win, down); a missing mood falls back to the portrait, then to the circuit. 'pairs': two-driver shots in drivers/pairs/<id>.webp. 'quotes': invented lines in each driver's voice from assets/teams/teams.json. Provenance of the art: assets/career/MEDIA-IMAGES.md.

win: The plan worked. It usually does.
I saw this result around lap two.
down: A bad position. There will be another game.
I will study it tonight, then it is over.

win: Tonight Saetta sings, and I sing the loudest!
Tell Varrone I saved him a seat in the crowd.
down: Even the best opera has a bad act.
I smile anyway. You should see the other guy's lap times.

win: I brake later. That is the whole secret.
Whistle all you like. I heard you from the top step.
down: I apologise to no one, and I am not starting today.
Ask me after I have looked at who pushed whom.

win: They charged. I stepped aside. It is not complicated.
Do not call me La Torera. Call me the winner.
down: Patience costs you, some days.
The bull had a good afternoon. There are other afternoons.

win: Terribly sorry to everyone I passed. I shall write.
My grandfather would have enjoyed that one.
down: My apologies to the team. And to the barrier.
The note is already in the post.

win: Same lap as always. The others got slower.
No rush. Never was.
down: Bit of a slow one. Good surf next week, though.
You don't fix that by hurrying.

win: Grip is overrated.
It was sideways for most of it. That was the good part.
down: It stopped sliding. That was the problem.
Fine. Next.

win: Valois can keep his crown warm for me.
Tell the old guys I am only getting started.
down: One lap I have. Racecraft I am learning, okay?
I will be faster next time. Write that down.

win: A lovely afternoon, wouldn't you say?
Very kind of them all to leave me the room.
down: Even a champion may enjoy the view from further back.
Jazz helps. Ask me tomorrow, I shall be charming.

win: One does not hurry. One arrives.
Le Prince may have the photographs. I shall take the points.
down: A sigh will suffice.
The tyres were pristine. It is some comfort.

win: That's how we do it at the county fair.
Stewards can have the replay. I'm keeping the trophy.
down: Somebody hit me first. I'll check who later.
Put it on my tab with the stewards.

win: All waypoints nominal. Mission complete.
Flew the plan. Nothing further to report.
down: Deviation logged. We will review the checklist.
Not the flight plan I filed.

win: This one belongs to the whole Corniche.
Valois, I am coming for that crown.
down: I am sorry to everyone who stood up for me today.
A city's patience is long. Mine is shorter.

win: I lost count of the passes. Did you?
Desert roads are harder than this. And there, nobody waves a flag.
down: I ran out of people to pass. That never helps.
Tomorrow I smile again. Tonight, a little less.

win: The apex is a suggestion. Today it was a good one.
Kuroda will tell you it was murder on the tyres. She is right, and I won.
down: Too much angle. Maybe. Lindqvist will say so, loudly.
I bowed to the marshal who helped me out of the gravel.

win: Lap fourteen, four tenths. That was the race.
It is in the logbook.
down: Two tenths on entry. It is in the logbook.
There is nothing to say that the numbers have not said.
